summary: Independent review of Jinshu ch. 080 units s0089–s0110 against the sealed Chinese only. These twenty-two units are continuous memorial counsel on grain transport, year-end ranking, contradictory paperwork, granary theft at Yuyao, corvée desertion, and commuting lighter capital and five-year sentences into labor. unitPeople lists no named person in any owned unit; ownedItems and ownedPeople are empty, so no itemChecks or personChecks were due. Date-like Chinese in the slice is administrative or relative, not a named person's birth, death, age, or dated life event: 歲終 (s0089) is a yearly evaluation cycle; 自吾到此 (s0092) marks tenure since an unnamed posting without a reign, era, or year; 十日 (s0094) is uninterrupted work time; 江左平日 (s0096) is a general contrast with ordinary Jiangzuo practice; 近 (s0098) and 近十萬斛 (s0099) are recency and quantity; 自軍興以來 and 死亡 (s0100) plus 死亡絕沒 and 十年、十五年 (s0105) describe anonymous wartime attrition and decade-long cases, not a named death or traditional age; 五歲刑 and 自今 (s0106) are a penalty term and a prospective policy. Context units s0080 and s0086–s0088 / s0111–s0113 name the Prince of Kuaiji, Lu Zhonglian, Wang Xizhi, Xie An, and the Kuaiji literary circle, but those units and people are outside this job. No omitted personal chronology was found in the owned slice, and no conversion or external calendar check was required.
